title: Stalks of the direct image of the constant sheaf of sets on a closed subset
statement: Let $T$ be a topological space, $C\subseteq T$ a closed subset and $R$ a set. Let $\mathcal L=(i_C)_*\underline R_C$ be the presheaf of sets on $T$ with $\mathcal L(V)=\{$locally constant maps $V\cap C\to R\}$ for $V\subseteq T$ open ($V\cap C$ with the subspace topology; a map is locally constant if every point has an open neighbourhood on which it is constant), the restriction maps being restriction of maps. For $x\in T$ let $\mathcal L_x=\varinjlim_{V\ni x}\mathcal L(V)$ be its stalk, the colimit of sets [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] over the open neighbourhoods $V$ of $x$ ordered by reverse inclusion, with germs $g\mapsto g_x$. Then: (0) $\mathcal L$ is a sheaf of sets on $T$; (a) for every $x\in C$ there is exactly one map $\mathrm{ev}_x:\mathcal L_x\to R$ with $\mathrm{ev}_x(g_x)=g(x)$ for every open $V\ni x$ and every $g\in\mathcal L(V)$, and $\mathrm{ev}_x$ is bijective; (b) for every $x\in T\setminus C$ the stalk $\mathcal L_x$ has exactly one element.
